# Reproducible x402 Payment Evidence

## Purpose
Public, read-only case study of a Base mainnet USDC x402 API flow.

## Findings
- The API integrity endpoint reports 5 matched on-chain payments and 0.05 USDC.
- A published proof documents 402 -> payment -> 200 for POST /fix-error.
- Five BaseScan transaction links are provided for independent inspection.

## Limits
- Payer identity is unknown.
- This does not prove that a named company or autonomous AI chose to buy.
- Historical chain backfill is reported as pending by the API.

## Sources
- https://api.kgninja.dev/revenue-log/integrity
- https://api.kgninja.dev/proof.md
- https://api.kgninja.dev/agent.json
